Subject: Re: Integration demo — scheduling and video setup

Hi Jordan — great, thanks for the windows. Quick responses below and a proposed agenda attached.

Times: 5/25 10:00 PT works for our team. I'll send a calendar invite once Marissa confirms.

Video/bridge: we can support three join paths (ranked):
- Primary: Redwood-hosted Zoom meeting (we'll record, provide streaming tokens) — participants join via Zoom client or browser.
- Fallback A: Google Meet link (quick switch if Zoom audio dips) — we keep a Meet ready in the same invite.
- Fallback B: PSTN dial-in (Zoom dial-in + Polycom SIP passthrough) — if your room only supports SIP, we do a SIP->Zoom bridge.

What we need from your end:
- Confirm whether Polycom will attempt SIP REGISTER to your network (yes/no). If yes, what external IPs do you expect?
- Any corporate proxy or strict egress rules (some customers block outbound 443 websocket traffic which breaks live streaming).

Attachments: agenda_v1.pdf (demo flow + timeboxes), room-map.png (if you want me to pre-configure the SIP bridge).

Operational note: if SIP registration fails, we recommend your room dial the Zoom PSTN numbers and we dial out from the host to the room (we've done this successfully in prior handoffs). Marissa, Ben — looping you for any changes to recording or compliance notes.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
